itemId.description: Identifier of the item linked to the investment

type.description:
Investment asset class.
- `MUTUAL_FUND`: actively managed pooled investment funds (FIM, FIA, FIC).
- `EQUITY`: stocks and equity-like assets traded on a stock exchange.
- `ETF`: Exchange Traded Funds.
- `FIXED_INCOME`: fixed income products such as CDB, LCI, LCA, debentures, Tesouro Direto.
- `COE`: Certificado de Operações Estruturadas (structured notes).
- `SECURITY`: private pension / previdência products (PGBL, VGBL).
- `OTHER`: any asset not covered by the categories above.

subtype.description:
Specific instrument within a `type`. Possible groupings:

**EQUITY**: `STOCK` (ação), `BDR` (Brazilian Depositary Receipt), `REAL_ESTATE_FUND` (FII), `DERIVATIVES`, `OPTION`.

**ETF**: `ETF`.

**FIXED_INCOME**: `TREASURY` (Tesouro Direto), `CDB`, `LCI`, `LCA`, `LC`, `LF`, `CRI`, `CRA`, `DEBENTURES`, `CORPORATE_DEBT`.

**MUTUAL_FUND**: `INVESTMENT_FUND`, `MULTIMARKET_FUND`, `FIXED_INCOME_FUND`, `STOCK_FUND`, `ETF_FUND`, `OFFSHORE_FUND`, `FIP_FUND`, `EXCHANGE_FUND`, `FI_INFRA`, `FI_AGRO`.

**COE**: `STRUCTURED_NOTE`.

**SECURITY**: `RETIREMENT` (PGBL/VGBL).

**OTHER**: `OTHER`.

number.description: Reference number for this holder's asset

balance.description: The current net balance amount of the investment

lastMonthRate.description: The performance rate of the investment in the last month

lastTwelveMonthsRate.description: The performance rate of the investment in the last 12 months

annualRate.description: The performance rate of the investment in the last year

currencyCode.description: Currency ISO code for the amounts

code.description: Associated Code for the investment. For example, the code for a mutual fund is the CNPJ

taxes.description: Income taxes applied to the investment

taxes2.description: Financial taxes applied to the investment

amountProfit.description: Profit/Loss to date over the investment

issuer.description: The entity that issued the investment

issuerCNPJ.description: The entity CNPJ that issued the investment

issueDate.description: The date that the investment was issued

purchaseDate.description: The date that the investment was purchased

gracePeriodDate.description: The date when the grace period ends (fixed-income investments only)

rate.description: Fixed rate percentage applied to the investment

taxExempt.description: Whether the product is tax-exempt (LCI, LCA, CRI, CRA, debêntures incentivadas)

ratePeriodicity.description: Periodicity of the remuneration rate (DAILY, MONTHLY, SEMESTERLY, YEARLY)

indexerAdditionalInfo.description: Free-text indexer description when the indexer is non-standard

debtor.description: Underlying debtor of receivables-backed paper (CRI / CRA)

couponPayment.description: Coupon-payment schedule for coupon-bearing fixed income / Treasury bonds

hasCoupon.description: Whether the paper pays periodic coupons

periodicity.description: Frequency of coupon payments (MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMESTERLY, YEARLY, IRREGULAR)

additionalInfo.description: Free-text detail when periodicity is IRREGULAR

status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the investment.
- `ACTIVE`: the investment is open and currently held by the owner.
- `PENDING`: the operation has been requested but is not yet settled (e.g. a fund subscription within the settlement window).
- `TOTAL_WITHDRAWAL`: the position has been fully redeemed/withdrawn; balance is zero.

createdAt.description: Date when the investment was first ingested by Pluggy.

updatedAt.description: Date of the last update of the investment data.

transactions.description: Movements of the investment. Only present on endpoints that return transactions inline; use `GET /investments/{id}/transactions` otherwise.

Company.description: Company object that holds the company's information

InvestmentExpenses.description: Taxes and fees that applied to the transaction

serviceTax.description: (ISS) Service tax that varies according to state

brokerageFee.description: Commission charged by the brokerage for carrying out transactions on the stock market

incomeTax.description: (IRRF) Income Tax Withholding, amount paid to the Internal Revenue Service

tradingAssetsNoticeFee.description: (ANA) Fee of Notice of Trading in Assets

maintenanceFee.description: (termo/opções) Fees charged by BM&F Bovespa in negotiations

settlementFee.description: Liquidation fee for the settlement of a position on the expiration date or the financial settlement of physical delivery

stockExchangeFee.description: (Emolumentos) Fees charged by BM&F Bovespa as a source of operating income

custodyFee.description: Fee by brokers to keep recordsin their home broker systems or on the trading desk

operatingFee.description: Amount paid to the Operator for the intermediation service

other.description: Sum of other not defined expenses

iof.description: (IOF) Tax on financial operations charged on the transaction

number.description: Identifier of the institution (CNPJ or other)

taxRegime.description: Description of the type of tax applied to previdencia

processNumber.description: Number of the process of a previdencia

fundName.description: Name of the fund associated with the previdencia.

anbimaCategory.description: Legacy Anbima category (FIXED_INCOME, STOCK, MULTIMARKET, EXCHANGE). Funds.

type.description:
Operation performed on the investment position.
- `BUY`: subscription / purchase of new quotas.
- `SELL`: redemption / sale of quotas.
- `TRANSFER`: portability or internal transfer between accounts (the `amount` field may be null).
- `TAX`: tax withholdings such as IR or IOF.
- `INTEREST`: interest or yield credited to the position.
- `AMORTIZATION`: principal repayment (typical of fixed-income amortizing bonds).

movementType.description:
Cash-flow direction of the transaction from the holder's perspective.
- `CREDIT`: money goes into the position (defaults for `BUY`).
- `DEBIT`: money leaves the position (defaults for `SELL`, `TAX`, `TRANSFER`, `INTEREST`, `AMORTIZATION`).

amount.description: Gross amount of the operation. May be null only if type is TRANSFER

indexerPercentage.description: Max percentage of the indexer agreed at contracting (e.g. 110% of CDI)

priceFactor.description: B3 lot/price conversion factor (variable income transactions)

date.description: Date when the transaction was made

tradeDate.description: Date when the transaction was confirmed

description.description: Description of the transaction as reported by the institution

netAmount.description: Amount of the operation after expenses and taxes

brokerageNumber.description: Brokerage note number the transaction belongs to
